description: We are a team of 4 BTech CSE (AI & ML) students participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are interested in space exploration, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analysis, and software development. We welcome motivated teammates who enjoy problem-solving, teamwork, and developing innovative solutions using NASA data. If you are interested in collaborating with us, please contact me through the NASA Space Apps team platform. Let's work together to build something impactful!
